title: Shepherd of love

lines.text: Shepherd of love, you knew I had lost my way,
Shepherd of love, you cared that Id gone astray.
Strong arms that carried me home,
No foe can harm me, nor alarm me,
Shepherd of love, Saviour and Lord and Guide,
Shepherd of love, forever Ill stay by your side.
